Thanks for contributing! This project uses release-please, which triggers
releases by scanning commit messages for Conventional Commits
(https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).

Please make sure your PR title (used as the merge commit message) starts
with one of: feat, fix, perf, deps, revert, docs, style, chore, refactor,
test, build, ci — e.g. "fix: correct RTSP reconnect loop".

Only "feat:" and "fix:" (and "!" breaking-change variants) trigger a new
release; the other types are included in the changelog but do not by
themselves cause a release.
